note: Every government or court host a skill cites should be registered here, so a URL change is fixed in one place. scripts/validate.py warns on unregistered .gov.in/.nic.in hosts and fails on hosts listed under 'deprecated'. Access notes are observations as of last_checked, not guarantees; a CAPTCHA is not a login wall and a 403 alone does not mean the source is closed.

sources.name: India Code
sources.what: Authoritative text of Central and State Acts with amendment history; the first stop for any section number.

sources.name: e-Gazette of India
sources.what: Commencement notifications, rules, amendments (S.O./G.S.R.).
sources.access: open; intermittently unreachable — retry before concluding a notification does not exist

sources.name: Supreme Court of India
sources.what: Judgments search by neutral citation (YYYY INSC NNN), case number or parties; judgment PDFs served from api.sci.gov.in (not a search API).

sources.name: e-SCR (Supreme Court Reports)
sources.what: Citation and keyword search over reported Supreme Court judgments.

sources.name: Verdict Finder
sources.what: Full-text search over Supreme Court judgments.

sources.name: eCourts (District Courts and High Courts)
sources.what: Case status, cause lists, orders (services.*), national judgments keyword search (judgments.*/pdfsearch/).
sources.access: CAPTCHA-gated; no public API for lawyers

sources.name: National Judicial Data Grid
sources.what: Pendency statistics. Not a source of orders or judgments.

sources.name: High Court judgment portals
sources.what: Each High Court's own judgment/order search and neutral-citation lookup; the e-Committee's national search aggregates most of them.
sources.access: varies; mostly CAPTCHA-gated; add a High Court's host here when a skill cites it

sources.name: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA V3)
sources.what: Company and LLP incorporation (SPICe+, FiLLiP), annual filings, master data, name search, fee calculator, circulars and rules.
sources.access: login for filings; master data and circulars open

sources.name: Income Tax Department
sources.what: Acts, rules, circulars, the Income-tax Act 2025 concordance utility (incometaxindia), and the e-filing portal (incometax.gov.in).
sources.access: open for law; login for e-filing

sources.name: GST portal and CBIC
sources.what: GST returns and notices (gst.gov.in), CGST Act/rules/circulars (cbic-gst.gov.in), Council decisions (gstcouncil.gov.in), GST Appellate Tribunal e-filing (gstat).
sources.access: law open; portal login for notices and filings

sources.name: Ministry of Labour & Employment
sources.what: Labour Codes, Central Rules (notified 8 May 2026), Model Standing Orders, Shram Suvidha registrations, EPFO and ESIC.
sources.access: open for law; login for registrations

sources.name: RTI Online and Information Commissions
sources.what: Central RTI applications and first appeals online; Central Information Commission decisions.
sources.access: login for filing; CIC decisions open

sources.name: Consumer Commissions (e-Daakhil, CONFONET, NCDRC)
sources.what: Online complaint filing, case status, NCDRC orders, Department of Consumer Affairs rules and notifications, National Consumer Helpline.
sources.access: login for filing; orders and rules open

sources.name: State RERA authorities (examples)
sources.what: Project registration search, complaint filing, Authority orders and State RERA Rules (prescribed interest rate, fees). One per State — confirm the domain is a government domain before relying on it.

sources.name: MeitY (DPDP Act and Rules)
sources.what: DPDP Act 2023, DPDP Rules 2025 (G.S.R. 843(E)–846(E), 13 Nov 2025), Data Protection Board notifications.

sources.name: CERT-In
sources.what: Cyber-incident reporting directions (28 April 2022) that run in parallel with DPDP breach duties.

sources.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
sources.what: Online reporting of cyber fraud and other cyber offences; helpline 1930.

sources.name: Reserve Bank of India
sources.what: Master directions (payment-data localisation, cheque validity, digital lending), Integrated Ombudsman (cms.rbi.org.in).

sources.name: SEBI
sources.what: Regulations, circulars, SCORES complaints.

sources.name: IBBI, NCLT and NCLAT
sources.what: Insolvency regulations, public announcements of CIRP (claim windows), NCLT/NCLAT cause lists and orders.

sources.name: NALSA, Tele-Law and Nyaya Bandhu
sources.what: Free legal aid (helpline 15100), Tele-Law counselling, pro bono panel, Department of Justice schemes.

sources.name: Legislative Department and PRS
sources.what: Bills and Acts as passed, Ministry of Law notifications, Press Information Bureau releases on commencement.

sources.name: Startup India and Udyam (MSME) registration
sources.what: DPIIT startup recognition (eligibility and benefits), Udyam MSME registration, MSME Samadhaan delayed-payment references.
sources.access: login to register; criteria pages open

sources.name: Ministry of Home Affairs and Bureau of Immigration
sources.what: Criminal-law notifications, NCRB Sankalan correspondence tables, Immigration and Foreigners Act 2025 rules, FRRO.

deprecated.why: legacy host showing a migration notice
legacy host showing a migration notice

excluded_note: Useful as leads and commentary; never the official copy. A judgment is verified only from a court portal, a statute only from India Code or the Gazette.
